APPROVE
I couldn't find the repository on this machine, so this verdict rests on the diff alone: the method body drops to a single loop with a guarded call (well under 15), the extracted helpers keep job order, results and early-exit logic intact (the lazy `yield` is consumed at once by `AddRange`), and it should build, assuming `WorkflowJobs`, `JobTokenUse`, `JudgedWriteGrants`, `TopLevelPermissionsIndex`, `FirstThree` and `PermissionsBlock` are static, as the neighbouring `static UnusedWriteScopeRow` suggests.
